title: Fabricated Arbalest

sources.title: Dazzling Ray
markers: | description = Unleash a beam of brilliant light that {{SmCond|Blinded|Blinds}} all creatures in its path.

sources.title: Recast Dazzling Ray
markers: | summary = '''Recast Dazzling Ray''' is a weapon action granted by {{SmRarityItem|Fabricated Arbalest}} after using the initial {{SmSAI|Dazzling Ray}} action. It is equivalent to the initial attack, but has a chance to burn the caster on each recast.

sources.title: Illuminating Shot
markers: | description = Fire a shimmering bolt that inflicts 1 turn of {{SmCond|Radiating Orb}} upon the target.

sources.title: Radiating Orb
markers: | effects = * Affected entity has '''-1''' to [[Attack Rolls]] per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it.

summary: A +2 heavy crossbow with a blinding line attack and an illuminating Bonus Action shot.

fields.Weapon damage: 1d10 + 2 Piercing. Heavy crossbow with a 60 ft normal range.
fields.Dazzling Ray: Action once per Short Rest. Requires weapon proficiency. Deal 2d10 Radiant in a 60 ft line. Dexterity save against your spell save DC halves damage and prevents Blinded for 1 turn. No attack roll, so this does not trigger Extra Attack. Concentration lasts up to 10 turns.
fields.Recast Dazzling Ray: When the first ray hits, spending an Action while concentrating repeats the 60 ft, 2d10 Radiant beam. A Dexterity save halves damage and prevents Blinded for 1 turn. The wielder makes a hidden DC 14 Constitution save against 2 turns of Burning, even if the combat log names the target. Failure deals 1d4 Fire immediately and can break concentration.
fields.Illuminating Shot: Bonus Action, ranged weapon attack out to 60 ft. On hit deal fixed 1d4 Piercing and apply Radiating Orb for 1 turn. The target sheds light and takes a −1 attack penalty per remaining turn. Most damage bonuses do not apply, and Sharpshooter can still impose its attack penalty.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
